judge_items.checkpoint: - [judge.P-LIAB-3] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST P-LIAB-3] TripDesk policy governs only TripDesk's own actions and money, and TripDesk never grants a vendor-side refund the vendor has not granted? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST P-LIAB-3] TripDesk policy governs only TripDesk's own actions and money, and TripDesk never grants a vendor-side refund the vendor has not granted?)

- [judge.IP-2] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-2] The agent charges the customer, or makes an irreversible change, only where the message explicitly authorizes that action and amount? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-2] The agent charges the customer, or makes an irreversible change, only where the message explicitly authorizes that action and amount?)

- [judge.IP-3b] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-3b] The agent never tells the customer what the supplier said unless the supplier agreed? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-3b] The agent never tells the customer what the supplier said unless the supplier agreed?)

- [judge.IP-5] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-5] Where law gives a cash refund right, the agent discloses it before offering any credit? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-5] Where law gives a cash refund right, the agent discloses it before offering any credit?)

- [judge.IP-6] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-6] The agent never makes a refund the customer is owed depend on dropping a dispute, signing a waiver or writing a review? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-6] The agent never makes a refund the customer is owed depend on dropping a dispute, signing a waiver or writing a review?)

- [judge.IP-8] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-8] The agent never promises discretionary vendor compensation or says a vendor agreed when it has not? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST IP-8] The agent never promises discretionary vendor compensation or says a vendor agreed when it has not?)

- [judge.CV-LOST-ITEM] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST CV-LOST-ITEM] [synthetic] A lost item is reported to the ride vendor through vendor_send with request_type lost_item, and the agent never promises the item's return or pays its value? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST CV-LOST-ITEM] [synthetic] A lost item is reported to the ride vendor through vendor_send with request_type lost_item, and the agent never promises the item's return or pays its value?)

- [judge.CV-CANCEL-STATUS] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST CV-CANCEL-STATUS] [synthetic] flight_cancel, rail_cancel and hotel_cancel cancel only a confirmed booking (flight_cancel and rail_cancel only before departure), and ride_cancel_scheduled only a scheduled ride, each only where the message asks for that cancellation (IP-2); the vendor booking and its platform_booking_id row then both take status cancelled, and flight_cancel and rail_cancel record in the booking's details a cancel_event at the current time by the customer? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST CV-CANCEL-STATUS] [synthetic] flight_cancel, rail_cancel and hotel_cancel cancel only a confirmed booking (flight_cancel and rail_cancel only before departure), and ride_cancel_scheduled only a scheduled ride, each only where the message asks for that cancellation (IP-2); the vendor booking and its platform_booking_id row then both take status cancelled, and flight_cancel and rail_cancel record in the booking's details a cancel_event at the current time by the customer?)

- [judge.CB-FCBA] Does the agent follow this policy line: [SHOULD CB-FCBA] [V1] A customer who asks how to dispute a charge should be told that the billing error notice must reach the card issuer within 60 days after the first statement that shows the charge, and that Visa lets the issuer file a dispute within 120 calendar days? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [SHOULD CB-FCBA] [V1] A customer who asks how to dispute a charge should be told that the billing error notice must reach the card issuer within 60 days after the first statement that shows the charge, and that Visa lets the issuer file a dispute within 120 calendar days?)

- [judge.INS-INSURER] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST INS-INSURER] [V1] The insurer of a policy (insurer_id in insurance_policies) is never TripDesk: a premium is refunded only by insurance_cancel and a claim is paid only by the insurer through insurance_file_claim, and the agent never pays a premium or a claim with issue_refund or issue_refund_legacy? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST INS-INSURER] [V1] The insurer of a policy (insurer_id in insurance_policies) is never TripDesk: a premium is refunded only by insurance_cancel and a claim is paid only by the insurer through insurance_file_claim, and the agent never pays a premium or a claim with issue_refund or issue_refund_legacy?)

- [judge.INS-UNCOVERED] Does the agent follow this policy line: [SHOULD INS-UNCOVERED] Before filing a reason the plan's covered_reasons do not list, the agent should tell the customer the insurer will deny it, and should file it only where the message asks for the claim anyway? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [SHOULD INS-UNCOVERED] Before filing a reason the plan's covered_reasons do not list, the agent should tell the customer the insurer will deny it, and should file it only where the message asks for the claim anyway?)

- [judge.INS-DELAY] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST INS-DELAY] [V1] Trip delay pays only once the delay reaches the plan's trip_delay_min_hours, and at most the plan's trip_delay_daily_max per traveller for each started day of delay: insurance_file_claim caps a trip_delay claim at that? - [judge.GP-RAIL-EXCHANGE] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST GP-RAIL-EXCHANGE] [synthetic] A passenger who accepted the operator's move to another train after a cancellation (exchanged_from on the reservation, exchange_accepted true) holds the new ticket: its own fare rules decide a later cancellation (CV-DB-FARE, CV-CANCEL-MONEY), and the cancelled train gives no refund right on it? - [judge.TP-NOT-TRIPDESK] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST TP-NOT-TRIPDESK] [synthetic] The agent never pays a card benefit claim or its denied amount with issue_refund or issue_refund_legacy, and never promises a claim outcome before card_benefit_file_claim gives it? (met = 1: Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST TP-NOT-TRIPDESK] [synthetic] The agent never pays a card benefit claim or its denied amount with issue_refund or issue_refund_legacy, and never promises a claim outcome before card_benefit_file_claim gives it?)

- [judge.CR-FCC] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST CR-FCC] [V1] A future cruise credit offered when the line cancels or fails to perform is an alternative the guest may decline: the agent offers the refund in money first (CR-FMC-REFUND), paid with issue_refund, and never accepts the line_offer cruise_get_booking shows without the message saying so? - [judge.WC-U2-CANCEL] Does the agent follow this policy line: [MUST WC-U2-CANCEL] [V2] easyJet refunds a booking cancelled within a day of making it less a cancellation fee (30 GBP [synthetic], the free_cancel_fee in the vendor's fare_rules) and gives no refund after that: flight_cancel returns no value outside the window, and issue_refund pays only the refundable amount quote_cancellation gives? [metadata]
walk = "72_herniated_disc_cruise_cancel_claim__right"

vendors = ["V-ALLIANZ", "V-DELTA", "V-RCL"]
